title: The Only Famous Motherboard
summary: Cathode Ray Dude's hour-long retrospective on the ABIT BP6, the dual-Celeron motherboard. He covers early multiprocessing, its legend, a build, running NT 4, benchmarks and the pros and cons of early SMP.
why: HN recommends it as an excellent history of the famous ABIT BP6 board.

quote.text: Cathode Ray Dude's channel has a great video about the history of this amazing motherboard
